name: Vector-Phosphor Oscilloscope
summary: A single glowing electron beam draws the whole film on a black scope face, and the anomaly is the moment the trace turns coral.
look: Black glass with a faint 10×8 graticule, tick-marked centre axes and a bezel of knobs and lit keys. Every word, number and wave is one bright teal stroke with a white-hot head and a decaying phosphor afterglow; coral is reserved for the faulty signal and the action keys.

components.name: Graticule
components.role: 10×8 grid with tick-marked centre axes; the constant instrument frame

components.name: Beam head
components.role: white-hot dot with two-layer teal bloom; the single pen that draws everything

components.name: Persistence trail
components.role: 3–5 stacked path clones at decaying opacity; phosphor afterglow

components.name: Measurement cursors
components.role: amber dashed ΔY / Δt lines that turn the anomaly into a number

components.name: Bezel strip
components.role: knobs plus lit hardware keys (Roll back, Acknowledge, Start free) as the UI layer

components.name: Lissajous idle
components.role: XY-mode loop that fills waiting moments and the end card

motion.name: Beam draw
motion.how: stroke-dashoffset at constant linear speed, never eased; one full-width sweep = 1 bar (2 s at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Phosphor decay
motion.how: trailing clones at 0.6 / 0.35 / 0.15 opacity offset 40–80 ms keep strokes alive between hits

motion.name: Trigger lock
motion.how: 6 frames of seeded horizontal jitter, then steps(1) snap to stable exactly on the 0:08 drop and each proof hit

story: Hook: six ghosted copies of one sine slide across an untriggered scope while the beam writes 'How many dashboards did you check today?'. Reveal: on the drop the trace locks, a pulse spike runs into the glowing Acme mark and 'Acme Pulse' burns in. Proof: a calm checkout-conversion trace falls and turns coral, amber cursors measure 'ΔY −18% · 09:42 · deploy #2231' and a lit Roll back key waits for the human. CTA: a Lissajous heartbeat idles behind the lockup, 'You ship. Pulse watches.' and a coral Start free key.
adapt: Swap the conversion trace for your own key time series (latency, sync lag, queue depth) and put your primary action on the lit bezel key; the cursor readout becomes your alert copy.

fit.risk: Thin glowing strokes can smear under social-video compression; keep beams at 3 px or more and text large.
